failed_workflow.observed_failure: Runtime artifact chunks are missing. Deployment must fail closed.

impact.engineering_effect: The defence branch cannot produce trustworthy green integrity evidence against the current staging candidate until its provenance contract is refreshed. The gate failed closed, so stale assumptions were not accepted.

root_cause: The long-lived defence branch evolved independently from the deployment/provenance lane. Its integrity gate still assumes a legacy base64-chunk runtime transport and an older reviewed Node image digest while current main uses a directly committed hash-pinned 0.6.76 tarball and a different immutable Node image digest.
containment: Keep the divergent security branch unmerged and non-deploying.
Do not weaken or bypass the failed immutable-artifact check to obtain a green run.
Treat current main deployment manifest plus Dockerfile and exact runtime artifact as the candidate provenance source of truth.
Do not alter the sealed 0.6.76 runtime to satisfy a stale branch test.
regression_required: Rebase or reconstruct Last Line Defence changes on current main without copying stale deployment files.
Run Last Line Defence Gates against the exact current deployment manifest, Dockerfile and runtime artifact.
Verify the runtime artifact directly from manifest.runtime_artifact and manifest.runtime_sha256.
Re-run WFM every-push security, runtime-integrity, external-intelligence, autonomous-recovery and customer-proof gates on the rebased candidate.
Reject merge if main moves incompatibly before final verification.

autonomous_runbook.trigger: defence gate fails because expected provenance transport or pinned runtime identity differs from current deployment manifest
autonomous_runbook.safe_action: isolate branch, classify as provenance/test drift, refresh branch from current main, reapply defence-only changes, rerun all gates
forbidden_actions: change current runtime artifact to match stale tests
grant an LLM merge, deployment or production authority

claim_boundary: Repository engineering evidence only. This does not indicate compromise of the live 0.6.76 staging runtime; it records fail-closed test/provenance drift in a divergent defensive development branch.
